root_cause: The post-merge terminalizer classified ordinary supabase/migrations/*.sql changes as unknown non-Netlify runtime. PR #4049 had an already-applied production migration and clean live runtime evidence, but the terminalizer had no dedicated migration-provider evidence class and therefore failed with UNWIRED_NON_NETLIFY_RUNTIME_READBACK.
prevention: Classify timestamped supabase/migrations/*.sql as a dedicated migration runtime class.
Require one machine-readable Terminal-Supabase-Migration-Readback marker for every changed migration, including exact version, name, APPLIED state, project ref and UTC observation time.
Keep Edge function provider readback, Netlify runtime readback and unknown backend path handling unchanged and fail-closed.
Persist migration readbacks in terminal evidence instead of treating migrations as verifier-only.

evaluation.expected: Migration-only runtime changes require explicit provider-applied evidence; missing evidence and unknown backend paths remain fail-closed.
